records.context: **THE ASSUMPTION TESTS ARE THEMSELVES TESTS.** On n = 3 Levene has almost no power, so "p = 0.7, variances are equal" actually means "we could not tell". Reading that as licence to use Student's t is how a screen reports a difference that is not there. Below :data:`MIN_N_FOR_ASSUMPTIONS` this module records the check as UNINFORMATIVE and selects Welch's t-test or Mann-Whitney, which costs a little power when the assumption did hold and protects the result when it did not. That asymmetry is the whole argument: one direction loses a bit of sensitivity, the other publishes a false positive.

records.source: **THE ASSUMPTION TESTS ARE THEMSELVES TESTS.** On n = 3 Levene has almost no power, so "p = 0.7, variances are equal" actually means "we could not tell". Reading that as licence to use Student's t is how a screen reports a difference that is not there. Below :data:`MIN_N_FOR_ASSUMPTIONS` this module records the check as UNINFORMATIVE and selects Welch's t-test or Mann-Whitney, which costs a little power when the assumption did hold and protects the result when it did not. That asymmetry is the whole argument: one direction loses a bit of sensitivity, the other publishes a false positive.
records.translation: **가정 테스트는 자체 테스트입니다.** n = 3에서 Levene은 검정력이 거의 없으므로 "p = 0.7, 분산이 동일합니다"는 실제로 "we could not tell"를 의미합니다. Student's t를 사용하기 위한 라이센스로 이를 읽는 것은 화면에 존재하지 않는 차이점이 보고되는 방식입니다. :data:`MIN_N_FOR_ASSUMPTIONS` 아래에서 이 모듈은 검사를 UNINFORMATIVE로 기록하고 Welch의 t-검정 또는 Mann-Whitney를 선택합니다. 이는 가정이 유지될 때 약간의 전력을 소비하고 그렇지 않을 때 결과를 보호합니다. 그 비대칭성은 전체 주장입니다. 한 방향은 약간의 민감도를 잃고 다른 방향은 거짓 긍정을 게시합니다.
